dct_description_sm:
The purpose of this dataset is to provide maintained runway locations as points. These points are the centroids of the Runway_Poly_25k dataset. Runways include airports, aerodromes, and airstrips managed by Transportation Aviation Yukon. The latitude and longitude locations in the table are based on the centroid of the runway.

Distributed from [GeoYukon](https://yukon.ca/geoyukon) by the [Government of Yukon](https://yukon.ca/maps) . Discover more digital map data and interactive maps from Yukon's digital map data collection.

For more information: [geomatics.help@yukon.ca](mailto:geomatics.help@yukon.ca)
